S1:1.text: and our Lord viſited Sara, as he had promiſed and fulfilled the things which he ſpake.

S1:25.text: And he rebuked Abimelech for the wel welof water, which his ſeruants had taken away by force. +

S1:26.text: And Abimelech anſwered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thy ſelfe dideſt not tel me, and I heard not of it but to day.

S1:28.text: And Abraham ſet ſeuen ewe lambes of the flocke apart.

S1:3.text: And Abraham called the name of his ſonne, which Sara bare him, :: Iſaac

S1:33.text: And Abimelech aroſe, and Phicol the general of his armie, and they returned to the land of the Paleſtines. But Abraham planted a groue in Berſabee, and called therupon the name of our Lord God eternal.

S6:12.text: To whom God ſaid: Let it not ſeem grieuous to thee for the boy, and for thy handmaid: al things that Sara shal ſay to thee, heare her voice: becauſe in Iſaac shal ſeed be called to thee.

S6:15.text: And when the water in the bottle was ſpent, she caſt the boy vnder one of the trees that were there.

S6:2.text: And she conceiued & bare a ſonne in her old age, at the time that God had foretold her.

S6:21.text: And he dwelt in the wildernes of Pharan, and his mother tooke a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.

S6:26.text: And Abimelech anſwered I knew not who did this thing: yea and thy ſelfe dideſt not tel me, and I heard not of it but to day.

S6:3.text: And Abraham called the name of his ſonne, which Sara bare him,(a) Iſaac:

S6:32.text: And they made a league for the wel of oath.

S6:6.text: And Sara ſaid: Laughter God hath made to me: whoſoeuer shal heare of it, wil laugh with me.

S6:7.text: And againe she ſaid: Who that shal heare of it would belieue Abraham, that Sara gaue ſucke to a ſonne, which she bare him now being an old man.

S6:9.text: And when Sara had ſeen the ſonne of Agar the Egyptian playing with Iſaac her ſonne, she ſaid to Abraham:

S9:1.text: And our Lord viſited Sara, as he had promiſed and I fulfilled the things which he ſpake.

S9:11.text: Abraham tooke this greuouſly for his ſonne.

S9:24.text: And Abraham ſaid: I wil ſweare.

S9:3.text: And Abraham called the name of his ſonne, which Sara bare him, :: Iſaac

S9:5.text: when he was an hundred yeares old: for at this age of his father, was Iſaac borne.
